newsitem.title: POLAND: Elektrim cuts H1 net due to provision.
newsitem.headline: Elektrim cuts H1 net due to provision.

text.p: The Polish trading and industrial firm Elektrim SA revised down first half earnings after it had made a provision for possible losses from a planned sell-off of unprofitable businesses, the firm's deputy head said.
The company revised down the first half net to 17.41 million zlotys, down 4.34 million from earlier reported.
"We are planning to sell two or three of our subsidiaries, which have losses, so we created a reserve of 4.34 million zlotys to avoid showing a loss after the sale," Jan Sobkiewicz told Reuters.
He declined to name the firms which were going to be sold.
Sobkiewicz said the forecast of 1996 net profit of 52 million zlotys remained unchanged, but added that it could be changed after the company analysed the third quarter results.
Last year the company netted 51.9 million zlotys on sales of 618.4 million zlotys.
